answer: Sybil resistance can come from random liveness interviews. Each epoch, 5% of identities receive an unscheduled micro-task with a 90-second window, graded by a randomly drawn peer who logs latency and pacing. Timing fingerprints correlating above 0.8 flag one operator's cluster. Like a glacier exposing strata, shared infrastructure leaves marks no costume hides. A flagged cluster posts a 500-token bond per member; repeat correlation burns it. A falcon-fast clone farm must then provision separate machines and pacing per marble-cut identity, pushing cost above any reward.
